title: Square of Primes Sequence
statement: Find the next number in the sequence: 4, 9, 25, 49, 121, 169, ___?
explanation: The numbers are squares of consecutive prime numbers: 2^2=4, 3^2=9, 5^2=25, 7^2=49, 11^2=121, 13^2=169. Next prime is 17, and 17^2 = 289.

title: Portrait Identification
statement: Pointing to a photograph of a boy, Suresh said, 'He is the son of the only son of my mother.' How is Suresh related to that boy?
explanation: The only son of Suresh's mother is Suresh himself. So the boy in the photograph is the son of Suresh. Therefore, Suresh is his Father.

title: Logical Deduction from Statements
statement: Statements: (1) All mangoes are golden. (2) No golden things are cheap. Conclusions: I. All mangoes are cheap. II. Golden mangoes are not cheap.
explanation: Since all mangoes are golden and no golden things are cheap, no mangoes are cheap. Thus, Conclusion I is false and Conclusion II (golden mangoes are not cheap) logically follows.

title: Distance and Direction from Origin
statement: A man walks 5 km South, then turns right and walks 3 km. He turns left and walks 5 km. In which direction is he now from his starting point?
explanation: From origin (0,0): South 5km -> (0, -5). Turn right (facing West) 3km -> (-3, -5). Turn left (facing South) 5km -> (-3, -10). The coordinates are negative X and negative Y, which is South-West.

title: Circular Table Positioning
statement: Six friends A, B, C, D, E, and F are sitting in a circle facing the center. E is to the immediate left of D. C is between A and B. F is between E and A. Who is to the immediate right of F?
explanation: Since they face center: E is immediate left of D. F is between E and A. To the immediate right of F is E, and to the left of F is A.
